columns.comment: Signal id: the CRM signal id (SIG-...), or EWS-<obligor>-<yyyyMM>-<trigger>, NEWS-EVT-<news id>, MKT-<issuer>-<yyyyMMdd>-<code>, XR-<agency rating id>, JPR-EVT-<JP rating id>, NOTE-<activity id>.
columns.name: signal_event_id

columns.comment: Date the signal was raised (EWS signals: first day of the month evaluated) - the grain date.
columns.name: signal_date

columns.comment: First day of the calendar month of the signal.
columns.name: month

columns.comment: Signal type code; join gold.dim_signal_type (e.g. DEPOSIT_SURPLUS, UTIL_HIGH, NEWS_EXPANSION, MARKET_52W_LOW, PARENT_RATING_UPGRADE).
columns.name: signal_code

columns.comment: Signal type name (from dim_signal_type).
columns.name: signal_name

columns.comment: Signal category, e.g. Wallet Leakage, Growth, Liquidity, Credit, News, Market, Rating, Internal Sentiment.
columns.name: signal_category

columns.comment: Polarity of this signal: Opportunity, Risk or Neutral. News takes the item sentiment (>= 0.2 Opportunity, <= -0.2 Risk, else the type default); rating actions: upgrade = Opportunity, downgrade / negative outlook = Risk.
columns.name: polarity

columns.comment: True when polarity = Opportunity.
columns.name: is_opportunity_signal

columns.comment: True when polarity = Risk.
columns.name: is_risk_signal

columns.comment: Data quadrant of the signal type: Internal Quantitative, Internal Qualitative, External Quantitative or External Qualitative.
columns.name: source_quadrant

columns.comment: Workflow that consumes the signal type: Opportunity Identification, Early Warning or Both.
columns.name: consumed_by

columns.comment: Feed the signal came from: crm_signal, ews_signal, news, market, ext_rating, jp_parent_rating or rm_note.
columns.name: source_feed

columns.comment: Producing engine of the signal type: crm_signal_engine, news_alerts, ews_engine, news_vendor, market_data, rating_agency, jp_share or crm_notes.
columns.name: source_system

columns.comment: Region of the data provider: JP for signals from the Japan (Tokyo HO) Delta Share, APAC for local feeds and vendors - filter JP for rating actions from JP-shared parent data.
columns.name: source_region

columns.comment: Id of the source record (CRM signal id, news id, agency or JP rating id, activity id, issuer|date, obligor|month|trigger).
columns.name: source_record_id

columns.comment: Client (raised on the legal entity) or Group (raised on the group / listed parent and attached to the group lead entity).
columns.name: signal_level

columns.comment: Surrogate key of the dim_client version valid on this row's date (SCD2 as-was join, D11); join to gold.dim_client.golden_client_sk for the client attributes at that time.
columns.name: golden_client_sk

columns.comment: Golden client the signal is about (group-level signals: the group's lead entity).
columns.name: golden_client_id

columns.comment: Client group (global parent group) id from the Tokyo HO group master (SYN-G-nnnn); join to gold.dim_client_group.
columns.name: client_group_id

columns.comment: RM who owns the signal: the CRM signal owner, the RM who wrote the note, else the client's primary RM at the signal date (dim_client as-was); join gold.dim_employee.
columns.name: owner_employee_id

columns.comment: Signal strength 0-1: CRM engine strength; EWS severity (High 1.0, Medium 0.6, Low 0.3); news 0.5 x relevance + 0.5 x |sentiment|; market move size; rating notches; |note sentiment|. Average it.
columns.name: strength

columns.comment: Sentiment -1..1 for news and RM-note signals; null for other feeds.
columns.name: sentiment_score

columns.comment: Short description: CRM signal detail, EWS detail, news headline, market move, rating rationale or RM note text (synthetic).
columns.name: signal_text

columns.comment: CRM signal status for CRM opportunity signals: New, Actioned, Converted or Dismissed; null for other feeds.
columns.name: source_status

columns.comment: False for EWS signals that also fired for the same obligor and trigger the month before (a persisting condition); true for first occurrences and every other feed.
columns.name: is_new_occurrence

columns.comment: Acknowledged by the RM: CRM signals whose status moved beyond New; RM notes (raised by the RM); any other signal when an RM logged a CRM activity with the client group within 30 days on or after the signal date. False = unacknowledged.
columns.name: is_acknowledged

columns.comment: Date of the acknowledgement (CRM action / status date or the first qualifying RM activity); null when unacknowledged.
columns.name: acknowledged_date

columns.comment: Days from the signal to its acknowledgement; null when unacknowledged.
columns.name: days_to_acknowledge

columns.comment: Pipeline opportunity the CRM signal converted into (null otherwise).
columns.name: linked_opportunity_id

columns.comment: True when the client (group-level signals: any client of the group) has an open pipeline opportunity at 30-Sep-2026.
columns.name: has_open_pipeline

columns.comment: True when a pipeline opportunity was created for the client (group-level: the group) on or after the signal date, or the CRM signal is linked to one.
columns.name: has_opportunity_since_signal

columns.comment: True when has_open_pipeline or has_opportunity_since_signal - false = a signal with no pipeline.
columns.name: has_pipeline

columns.comment: Days between the signal date and the as-of date 30-Sep-2026; last N days = days_before_as_of < N.
columns.name: days_before_as_of

columns.comment: True for signals in the 30 days to 30-Sep-2026.
columns.name: is_last_30d

columns.comment: True for signals in the 90 days to 30-Sep-2026 (3-Jul-2026 .. 30-Sep-2026).
columns.name: is_last_90d

comment: Unified signal feed consumed by Opportunity Identification and Early Warning: every signal from every source keyed to gold.dim_signal_type - CRM opportunity signals (e.g. DEPOSIT_SURPLUS, TRADE_CORRIDOR_GROWTH), EWS triggers (e.g. UTIL_HIGH, DPD_30; monthly), news items (NEWS_*), market moves on listed parents (MARKET_*), external agency rating actions (EXT_RATING_*, EXT_OUTLOOK_NEGATIVE), JP parent rating actions from the Japan share (PARENT_RATING_*, source_region JP) and positive / negative RM notes (RM_NOTE_*). Group-level signals (market, agency, JP parent) sit on the group's lead entity. Each signal has a polarity (Opportunity / Risk / Neutral), a strength 0-1, an owner RM, an acknowledged flag and pipeline flags. Flow fact: count signals, average strength. Grain: one row per signal event.
